content.name: Oliver Brennan
content.title: Graduate Financial Analyst
content.summary: Economics graduate with a First from the University of Manchester, now in a graduate finance scheme at a regional retail bank and studying for CIMA. Builds monthly cost reports for a £45m operations budget and automated a reconciliation that took the team a full day each month.

experience.title: Graduate Financial Analyst
bullets: Prepare monthly cost-centre reports for a £45m operations budget and explain variances over £25k to budget holders.
Automated the monthly headcount-to-payroll reconciliation with Power Query, freeing up a full working day each month.
Supported the 2025 budget round by consolidating 34 departmental submissions and flagging £1.3m of duplicated costs.
Rotated through treasury, where I built a daily liquidity dashboard used by the ALCO secretary.

experience.title: Summer Analyst
bullets: Built comparable-company tables for two mid-market sell-side mandates in the leisure sector.
Cleaned and analysed five years of management accounts for a £12m-turnover target.
Drafted sections of an information memorandum reviewed by the deal director.

education.details: Dissertation: regional house prices and bank lending, 2010 to 2022

achievements.title: Investment society treasurer
achievements.detail: Managed the University of Manchester student investment fund's £8k portfolio and reporting, 2023 to 2024.
